_comment: THE ONE PLACE THE APP'S IDENTITY IS DEFINED. Every other file derives from
it: capacitor.config.json, the Android applicationId, the iOS bundle id, the
store listings, and the generated www/. Change a value here and re-run
`npm run build` in mobile/ — do not hand-edit the derived files.
displayName: what appears under the icon and at the top of both store
listings. OWNER, 2026-08-08, on seeing 'Put Scrivara on your iPhone' on his
own phone: 'this should save mlsscribe everywhere, fix everywhere what it
says the wrong thing to.' So it is 'MLS Scribe' — his brand and his domain.
It is deliberately NOT bare 'MLS': the full workspace already installs under
that name (manifest.webmanifest short_name), and two icons reading 'MLS' on
one Home Screen are indistinguishable. 'MLS Scribe' also keeps the earlier
store concern answered — bare 'MLS' reads as Multiple Listing Service.
appId: the bundle identifier / applicationId. It is PERMANENT. Once a build
is uploaded under it, neither store lets you change it — a different id is a
different app with a different listing, a different review, and no upgrade
path for anyone who installed the first one. Decide it before the first
